$comment: D1 routing. Only the SPA's virtual routes rewrite to board.html: /jobs/* (job pages + all-jobs index) and /{state}[/...] (browse). Everything else — / (index.html/landing), /board.html, /data,/ui,/vendor assets, /styles.css, and future reserved sections (/guides, /employers, ...) as they are added as real files — is served from the filesystem, which Vercel checks before these rewrites. The state list IS the top-level namespace: a new top-level section must be added to the reserved set and must never equal a state slug. Run `vercel dev` from this dir to exercise paths locally (python http.server does not rewrite).
